verdict.rationale: CrewAI's Task/Process/Flow model lets a crew be orchestrated to work through many items in one run, and a real hands-on example (an email-triage agent processing/categorizing/deleting large volumes of emails) shows bulk-style automation working in practice, but there is no documented dedicated bulk/batch API (e.g., a 'kickoff for each item' primitive) in the evidence pack, and a competitor notes CrewAI lacks persistent state/pause hooks that would make large-scale bulk runs safer. missing for 10: explicit documented bulk/batch execution primitive, performance/scale benchmarks for large item counts, and native safeguards (pause/resume, dry-run) for bulk destructive actions.
